const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""Vision-guided controller for the live Meta-World soccer episode.
+
+Run phases explicitly so each observation can be reviewed before continuing:
+  python /app/output/gen.py observe
+  python /app/output/gen.py approach
+  python /app/output/gen.py push
+
+The controller uses only camera pixels, camera calibration, proprioception,
+and task target_pos returned by the standard-mode service.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]
+DT = 0.0125
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, name: str) -> None:
+    for camera, rgb in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(OUT / f"{name}_{camera}.png")
+    for camera, depth in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"{name}_{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (OUT / f"{name}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def state(obs) -> dict:
+    names = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    values = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    p = dict(zip(names, values))
+    return {
+        "tcp": [p["tcp_x"], p["tcp_y"], p["tcp_z"]],
+        "mocap": [p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], p["mocap_z"]],
+        "gripper_opening": p["gripper_opening"],
+        "target_pos": obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"],
+        "time_left_s": obs.meta["time_left_s"],
+        "control_steps": obs.meta["control_steps"],
+    }
+
+
+def observe(robot: Robot, label: str):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+    save_observation(obs, label)
+    print(json.dumps(state(obs)))
+    return obs
+
+
+def move_mocap(robot: Robot, obs, delta_m, label: str, grip: float = -1.0):
+    """Move the native mocap target by delta_m in small, fixed 12.5 ms steps."""
+    d = np.asarray(delta_m, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.max(np.abs(d)) / 0.004)))
+    per_step = d / n
+    actions = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+    actions[:, :3] = per_step / 0.01
+    actions[:, 3] = grip
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
+        cameras=CAMERAS, video="mp4", note=label,
+    )
+    if res.done:
+        print(json.dumps({"done": True, "reason": res.meta.get("reason")}))
+        return None
+    obs2 = observe(robot, label)
+    return obs2
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "observe"
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    assert spec["protocol"] == "eai-standard/2.1"
+    obs = observe(robot, f"{phase}_before")
+    if phase == "observe":
+        return
+
+    if phase == "approach":
+        # The initial mocap target is (0, .60, .20). Move laterally to a
+        # point behind the ball while descending, with the fingers open.
+        obs = move_mocap(robot, obs, [0.100, -0.030, -0.095], "approach_low")
+        return
+
+    if phase == "push":
+        # The live approach observation is used to preserve the measured TCP
+        # to mocap offset. Contact starts about 4.5 cm behind the estimated
+        # ball center; then advance along the line to the task target.
+        target = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)[:2]
+        ball = np.array([0.070, 0.640], dtype=float)
+        push = target - ball
+        push /= np.linalg.norm(push)
+        tcp = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:3], dtype=float)
+        mocap = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][4:7], dtype=float)
+        # Keep the arm at its measured height and move to the rear contact
+        # point. The calibrated lateral offset is measured from live state.
+        contact_tcp = np.array([*(ball - push * 0.045), 0.045])
+        contact_mocap = mocap + (contact_tcp - tcp)
+        obs = move_mocap(robot, obs, contact_mocap - mocap, "align_behind_ball")
+        if obs is None:
+            return
+        # Move the hand far enough to carry the ball through the target, at a
+        # controlled 4 mm per native step, while keeping the gripper open.
+        obs = move_mocap(robot, obs, [*(push * 0.305), 0.0], "drive_ball_to_goal")
+        return
+
+    raise SystemExit(f"unknown phase: {phase}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
